name: Baby Corn Masala
steps: Blanch halved baby corn in boiling water for 3 minutes, then drain. Soak cashews in hot water 10 minutes and blend with 70 ml measured water until smooth.
Heat oil in a wide pan. Add cumin and onion; cook 6–7 minutes until golden. Stir in ginger-garlic paste for 1 minute.
Add tomato puree, coriander powder, chili and salt. Cook 7–8 minutes until thick and glossy. Stir in cashew paste and remaining 130 ml water.
Add baby corn and bell pepper. Cover and simmer 6 minutes until corn is tender but still slightly crisp and the pepper remains bright.
Add garam masala, taste salt, and simmer uncovered 2 minutes if the gravy is thin. Garnish with coriander and serve with roti.
tips: Use tender baby corn and avoid overcooking so its characteristic crunch remains.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
